reviewSamples.text: Outstanding service from this air conditioning company. The technician, Orestes Garcia, was punctual, professional, friendly and clearly knowledgeable. Communication was excellent throughout the entire process, and everything was explained in a way I could easily understand. Excellent customer service, fair pricing and quality work.

note: Discovery source: Google Business Profile (5.0/128 reviews confirmed directly). 9 real photos from GBP photo album (team+van, residential AC units, commercial rooftop crane install, attic air handler, electrical repair, yard sign with email). 3 verbatim Google reviews with named authors and technicians (Orestes Garcia, David). Email found printed on business yard sign photo. No Instagram/Facebook handle confirmed despite deep search (sign shows social icons but no legible handle). No own website (Housecall Pro booking only, third-party). Built on dark-v2 skeleton with a copper/burnt-orange palette (distinct from amber caramel and teal used earlier same day on other tree-service demos). Gate OK on first real attempt.
